method.heating: HEAT_1..HEAT_39 retained by layer; maxima summarize complete vertical profiles
method.mcse: sd_delta / sqrt(32), an approximate Monte Carlo standard error only
method.operational_difference: value37 - value4 for the actual deterministic selected-column result
method.paired_sampling_sd: CSV sd_delta; checked against |sd37-sd4| <= sd_delta <= sd37+sd4 and implied covariance/correlation bounds
method.units: As defined by the generating audit; no new unit reinterpretation

scope_limitations: This is a selected positive-ice column and two radiative source times only.
Estimator unbiasedness is not established for this selected case; the 32-seed MCSE is descriptive, not a confidence guarantee.
Operational-minus-ensemble-mean is a residual of the actual paired radiation difference from its ensemble mean, not a feedback estimate.
Radius mode 0 here means operational RA4 generic radii versus RRTMGP37 native radii; composition/optics differ as well, so differences are not solver-only attribution.
Do not extrapolate this one opaque, graupel/hail-positive column to the full domain, large flux biases, or coupled forecasts.
This analysis does not establish a reference pass.
